title: Recover an identity draft after a mismatched acknowledgement
description: A commander submits a second identity with a deliberately reused command UUID. The real encrypted ingress rejects the mismatched acknowledgement without losing the draft; a new command saves it and reload recovers the accepted identity.

steps.description: Deliberately reuse the browser command UUID while preserving real encryption entropy, authenticated ingress, persistence and receipt validation. Sign in through the ordinary Google emulator UI.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Choose the identity to save first.
steps.acknowledgement: The identity draft is ready to save.
verifications: The alias is visible before commitment.

steps.description: Save the first identity and wait for its authoritative acknowledgement.
verifications: Canonical identity remains at revision 1 with 1 versions and receipts.

steps.description: Prepare a different identity while the original stays saved.
verifications: Canonical identity remains at revision 1 with 1 versions and receipts.
The unsaved replacement does not inherit the prior save acknowledgement.

steps.description: Submit the replacement with the reused command ID. The acknowledgement belongs to different content, so the draft is retained for a fresh save.
verifications: Canonical identity remains at revision 1 with 1 versions and receipts.
The draft survives without a misleading validation error or retry of the colliding command.

steps.description: Restore ordinary random command UUIDs; do not change the retained draft, receipt or persisted identity.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Save the retained draft as a new command and receive its matching acknowledgement.
steps.acknowledgement: The fresh identity command is acknowledged.
verifications: Canonical identity remains at revision 2 with 2 versions and receipts.

steps.description: Reload and reopen the identity saved by the fresh command.
verifications: Canonical identity remains at revision 2 with 2 versions and receipts.
